description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveTypeDao in the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It contains unit tests verifying CRUD operations, list retrieval, search functions, and deletion/undelete logic for LeaveType entities.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LeaveTypeDao, testing CRUD operations, list retrieval, search, and delete/undelete functionalities on LeaveType entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveTypeDao object and populates test data from YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of LeaveType list with expected ordering and content.

methods.name: _getLeaveTypeObjectWithValues
methods.description: Creates a LeaveType object with predefined values for testing save operations.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests that saving a LeaveType returns an object of type LeaveType with ID assigned.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeCheckSavedType
methods.description: Checks that the saved LeaveType has correct attributes and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Validates deletion of LeaveType by IDs returns expected count.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Ensures that after deletion, the LeaveType is marked as deleted in the database.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of deleted LeaveTypes and verifies their properties and order.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Confirms that all items in the deleted list are instances of LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Checks the count of deleted LeaveType entries.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Verifies that deleted LeaveTypes do not contain certain IDs and names.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Validates the IDs and names of deleted LeaveTypes are as expected and in specific order.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Checks that undeleting a LeaveType returns a LeaveType object with correct state.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Confirms the LeaveType is unmarked as deleted after undelete.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies list updates correctly after undelete operation.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameType
methods.description: Checks retrieval of LeaveType by name, including null for non-existing names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameValues
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving by name yields correct LeaveType object.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of LeaveType by ID, for both active and deleted entries.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectWrongArgument
methods.description: Verifies null response for invalid IDs.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdValues
methods.description: Checks that retrieved LeaveType by ID has correct ID and name.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures that all LeaveTypes in list are instances of LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of LeaveType list matches expectations.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Checks that list does not include certain IDs and names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Validates the order and specific IDs/names in the LeaveType list.

methods.name: _compareLeaveTypes
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual LeaveType arrays.

methods.name: _compareLeaveType
methods.description: Helper method to compare two LeaveType objects for equality of attributes.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Tests count of leave types matching certain filter criteria.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveType
methods.description: Tests that search returns expected LeaveType objects in correct order.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeSearchByName
methods.description: Checks that search filters by name correctly.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies search respects limit parameter.
